hypothesis: Reading each token's embedding row in place from the checkpoint, instead of building the 2 GB f32 table at start, leaves the logits unchanged and, on an 8 GB Mac that swaps with the table, makes the 32 tokens generated after a 512-token prompt faster.
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration) converted to Colibri's qwen36 container: INT4 routed experts with gs=64 group scales, f16 dense weights (quantized to INT8 at load) and f16 embedding; 23 GB of safetensors
command: for each version, git archive <its commit> c | tar -x -C <dir>, then from the repository root, with the flags of make -C c qwen36: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -I<libomp>/include -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -I<dir>/c docs/experiments/qwen36-embedding-in-place-2026-10-07/bench.c -o <dir>/qwen36-bench -lm -L<libomp>/lib -lomp; every run: /usr/bin/time -l env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME SNAP=<model> <dir>/qwen36-bench promessi_sposi.txt 64,512 32; baseline = dev 94dee9d2, trial = 0d5eae65; 2633451f is the measured 0d5eae65 (a local commit not in the repository) with four small changes to how qwen36.c loads the embedding (a line on stderr when it reads the rows in place, COLI_EMBED_MMAP read by its first character, the tensor's name resolved as for the other dense tensors, the table kept only when Vulkan is on at run time instead of in every VK=1 build), a clearer line of the test's output, the docs, a CI step and the commit message (on the tiny fixture its layer outputs and logits are dev's, byte for byte), rebased onto dev 1509ea5b: the harness compiles to the same code section on the M1 from dev 1509ea5b as from dev 94dee9d2, and from 2633451f as from 71d56e35, a local commit, the code commit before the rebase

hardware.cpu: Apple M1, 4 performance + 4 efficiency cores (MacBook Air, MacBookAir10,1, no fan)

config.SNAP: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Colibri qwen36 container, INT4 experts gs=64, internal SSD
config.BUILD: flags of make -C c qwen36 on macOS: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp, no -mcpu, no METAL
config.EXPERT_CACHE: 16 experts per layer, set by the harness (qwen36's default until dev sized the cache from the RAM, which the harness does not use)
config.PROMPT: the first 64 and the first 512 tokens of promessi_sposi.txt (speed-bench/promessi_sposi.txt of antirez's ds4 at commit 0aaea5a, of which the harness reads the first 20,480 bytes; prompt_hash is its SHA-256), each from an empty state; after each, 32 greedy tokens
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run (baseline, discarded), then baseline trial trial baseline baseline trial trial baseline, one process each
config.REST: thermal state nominal, then 60 s, before every run
config.MEASURED: tokens per second of the 32 tokens generated after the 512-token prompt (the first token excluded)

quality.method: FNV-1a fingerprint of every logit of the run, and the hash of the generated tokens, per prompt length: 64 tokens f1300d8431ba2787/833c8fed434981a0, 512 tokens 8e0bf69c62deb041/a85d82db8081fff4, the same in all nine runs of both versions
